events.name: Island Trial: Normal

remembers.intro:
A hollow tree on a beach. Captain Yuri leans against it. You look down: there is a Z-Ring on your wrist. There was not a moment ago.

Captain Yuri: "You carry a Z-Ring. So you're doing the Trials."
Captain Yuri: "Three this run. Pass all three and the Kahuna will see you."
Captain Yuri: "Each of our Totems has a reason it's big. Find out why, and you'll know how to win."

events.intro:
Captain Yuri waits at a grassy shrine.

Captain Yuri: "Here's the puzzle. Then the Totem. You can quit anytime. No shame."

success.text: The puzzle is short and strange, and at the end of it the Totem Gumshoos rises, huge and glowing.

Captain Yuri: "It is big because it is hungry. Somebody fed it once, for a whole summer, and then left. It has been waiting for them at the shrine ever since."

Knowing it, you might not have to fight it at all.
Captain Yuri: "It'll be here till the region ends."

She holds out a crystal the colour of your oldest friend.

success.text: She does not battle. She only nods, once, the way Captains bow.

events.intro: Kahuna Olivia, on the steps of the shrine: "Three. Good. Now me."

success.text: Olivia: "Don't hold back. I won't."
Olivia: "I'll be here."

events.name: A Sigil in the Stone

remembers.notice: Oriel is here again. She hands you a sheet of paper: a sigil rubbing, both halves. "One free pair. I traced it in the first ruin. Don't tell anyone."

success.text: A pair of sigils on paper, still faintly warm. Kept for when you need them.

effects.text: Oriel gave you a sigil rubbing.

events.intro:
A ruined wall. A carved sigil glows. It matches nothing in the guidebook.

Scholar Oriel, copying it: "There's another one. There's always another one. They come in pairs."
Oriel: "One's here. The other is somewhere water's touched it."
Oriel: "When both are lit, something steps out. It's not a Mega. It's older."

success.text: You copy the sigil into your journal. The next stage, you will look for water.
Oriel: "A Z-form is a Pokémon with its second shape showing. You can earn one, or you can make one of yours." She writes her name in your journal, next to the sigil.
The sigil stays lit behind you, for as long as you are in this region.

events.name: The Sigil Pool
events.intro: The water in a rock pool is humming. A second sigil lies on the bottom. When you lean over it, the first one, a whole stage behind you, answers.

success.text: Both sigils burn together. Something in the glow takes a shape.
The humming follows you a little way, then stops.

events.name: The Z-Form Trial
events.intro: Both sigils burn together. A Z-form steps out of the glow to test you: a Pokémon you know, with its second shape showing.

success.text: It is not angry. It wants to see what you are.
It looks at you a while, then fades back into the stone.

events.name: The Sigils: After
events.intro: The test is over. The glow is going out of the sigils. Whatever you did not catch is already walking back into the stone.

success.text: You trace both halves into your journal before the glow goes. A pair, kept. Something that is yours can be re-shaped with them, one day.
They fade. The wall is just a wall.

events.name: The Cold Ghost

remembers.notice: Your starter's flame leans toward it, the way you lean toward a friend across a room.

branches.text: They sit together. They become friends at once. When it sees your sigils it reaches for them, and the frost on it turns to something brighter.

success.text: They sit together. Your starter's flame does not melt it; it only warms it a little. They become friends at once, and it comes with you, already changing.

events.intro:
The deepest, coldest cave. Frost on the walls makes a face, and the face moves. It is a Gastly made of frost, not gas.

It drifts close. Your breath freezes. It touches your sleeve. The sleeve frosts. It pulls back, sad.
Miner, at the cave mouth, later: "That's the one froze in the collapse. Came back. Brought the cold with it."
Miner: "It wants to be warm. It can't be."

choices.label: Take it to the hot spring.

success.text: Two nodes to the spring. It sits in the steam and does not melt. It is a little less sad. It stays with you.

branches.text: The two sit together. They become friends. It sees your sigils and drifts to them on its own, and you keep the stone that comes out of the frost.

success.text: The two sit together, a little apart, then closer. They become friends.

choices.label: Let it stay in the cold.

success.text: It is happiest here. It stays. Before you go it leaves something on your bag: a shard of ice that does not melt.

events.name: The Spoon That Bent the Wrong Way
events.intro: Night at camp. A pop of air. An Abra, transparent at the edges, picks up your spoon. It vanishes.

success.text: You wake with one spoon fewer.

events.name: The Spoon That Bent the Wrong Way: Second Night
events.intro: Second night: the same pop of air, the same transparent Abra, the same spoon.

success.text: You put your last spoon out, on purpose.

events.name: The Spoon That Bent the Wrong Way: Third Night
events.intro: Third night: you are awake. It stares back at you, holding the spoon. Your Psychic-type sits up, looks at it, and nods toward the trees.

success.text: Into the woods, a long way, the Abra blinking in and out ahead of you.
It fades a little, holding on, and lets go. It does not come back.
It takes it. The next night it brings one back, bent. And the night after. Three bent spoons, lined up by your bag. The fourth night, it waits for you at the trees.

events.name: The Spoon That Bent the Wrong Way: The Grave

remembers.notice: You still have the three bent spoons it brought you.

addChoices.label: Lay the three bent spoons on the pile.

branches.text: You lay them down. It laughs, and evolves, and takes the straight spoon. When it sees your sigils, it holds them too, and something older in it wakes.

success.text: You lay them down with the others. It looks at them, and at you, and then it laughs, for the first time. It evolves, and it takes one spoon, straight now, to carry forever.

events.intro:
A grave in the woods, with a pile of bent spoons on it, and a magician's hat rotted flat.
A wooden marker: "THE GREAT PELLO. HE BENT THEM BACK."
The Abra lays the spoon on the pile and looks at you.

branches.text: You leave them. It evolves, and comes with you. When it sees your sigils, it holds them, and something older in it wakes.

success.text: You leave them. It looks at the pile a long time. Then it evolves, and comes with you.
You gather the spoons. It fades, for good. The hat is just a hat.

branches.text: It laughs, for the first time, and evolves, and takes the straight spoon. When it sees your sigils, it holds them too.

success.text: Your Psychic-type takes a spoon and bends it straight. The Abra laughs, for the first time. It evolves, and it carries the straight spoon forever.

events.name: The Snorlax That Learned to Fight
events.intro:
A dojo in the hills. A Snorlax, awake, doing push-ups. The floor shakes with each one.

Black Belt Doran, sitting by the wall: "Don't look at me. I told it it couldn't."
Doran: "I said, a Snorlax will never be a fighter. That was a year ago. It hasn't slept since."
The Snorlax stops. It looks at you and points at the mat.

success.text: It is slow, and it is strong, and it is trying so hard.
Doran: "It doesn't want sorry. It wants to win." He waves at the mat. "Go on, then."
It keeps training. You hear the floor shake all the way down the hill.

events.name: The Snorlax That Learned to Fight: Second Spar
events.intro: Doran's Snorlax has walked all the way down to the road to find you. It points at the grass. Here will do.

success.text: It is faster than last time.

events.name: The Snorlax That Learned to Fight: Third Spar
events.intro: The third time. Doran has come too. He sits on a rock and does not say anything. The Snorlax bows to you, properly, the way he must have taught it.

success.text: It does not hold back.

events.name: The Snorlax That Learned to Fight: After
events.intro: The Snorlax stands over your Pokémon, panting. It looks at Doran.

success.text: Doran, very quietly: "...You can." It lies down where it stands and sleeps, for the first time in a year. Doran gives you a Munchlax from the dojo's litter. "It'll want to fight. Let it."

effects.text: Black Belt Doran told his Snorlax it could. It slept for the first time in a year.

success.text: The sigils light in your hands. It becomes something new in Doran's arms, and he cries. When it is done he gives you a Munchlax from the litter, and the stone it left behind.

effects.text: Doran's Snorlax took its second shape in his arms.

events.name: The Snorlax That Learned to Fight: Still Training
events.intro: A region on, a huge Snorlax in the road, doing push-ups. It is an Alpha now. It is very, very tired. It points at the grass.

success.text: It fights like it has not slept in a year, because it hasn't.
You step round it. It does not stop.

events.name: The Alpha of Alphas

remembers.notice: It looks at you a long time. Then it lowers its head, as if it had already decided.

success.text: It bows. Every Alpha you calmed howls once more, far away. It does not leave you a pup, this time.

remembers.notice: It sniffs the air. It knows you fed one of its own once. The test will start at the second round.

events.intro:
Night. From every direction, every Alpha you calmed this run howls once, at the same time.
On the hill ahead, a huge hyena shape, black and grey, with a mane like a storm.

Ine, if you met her, at your side: "That's the one they answer to."
Ine: "It's noticed you calming them. It wants to know if you meant it."

branches.text: It knows you. It skips the hunt. The second round is the hold.

success.text: It turns and lopes into the dark. The first round is the hunt.
It watches you go. Then it leaves too.
It eats it, and watches you. Then the test.

events.name: The Alpha of Alphas: The Hunt
events.intro: A wild Pokémon bolts out of the long grass. The Alphayena looks at you: catch it, without harming it.

success.text: Soothing sounds, a sweet scent, a balm: anything but a blow.

events.name: The Alpha of Alphas: The Hold

remembers.notice: It knows you beat a Noble down instead of calming it. It is angry. Seven turns, not five.

success.text: It comes at you, and it does not stop.

events.intro: The Alphayena itself steps forward. Survive five turns against it.

success.text: It comes at you, and it does not stop.

events.name: The Alpha of Alphas: The Howl
events.intro: The last round. It lifts its head and howls, and waits for your team to answer.

success.text: Every one of your Pokémon that knows a sound move lifts its head and answers, together.
Your team is quiet. It waits, then lowers its head.

events.name: The Alpha of Alphas: The Verdict
events.intro: The Alphayena stands over you on the hill. The Alphas have gone quiet.

branches.text: It bows. A Poochyena pup trots out of the dark and sits at your feet. It is yours, from its own pack.

effects.text: The Alpha of Alphas bowed to you and gave you a pup from its pack.

branches.text: It looks at you a long time, then leaves, respectful.

success.text: It marks you, one long look, as prey. Then it is gone.
